about_the_game:
🕹️ A GAME ABOUT NOSTALGIA

From the creator of KinnikuNeko: SUPER MUSCLE CAT comes...

Nostalgic Joe - And The Fairy Whispers
A cinematic narrative adventure that feels like finding an old VHS tape of your own memories.

Play as Joe Thompson, a failed musician who finds a mysterious fairy trapped inside a VHS player — and discovers that nostalgia itself can become magic.

Explore a small 3D town brought to life through 90’s anime-style characters, dive into surreal dreams, collect Heartbound objects filled with emotional memories, and uncover how the past can both heal and haunt us.

🌀 FEATURES

• Retro VHS visuals with 90s anime aesthetics
• Atmospheric storytelling with cinematic camera work
• Classic point & click mechanics with free movement
• Emotional side quests that touch the heart
• Light action and nostalgic mini-games (Game Boy, NES, Tamagotchi, etc.)
• Original Y2K / Frutiger Aero-inspired soundtrack
• Frame-by-frame animations inspired by hand-painted cels

This is not a game for everyone.
It’s an adult-themed, story-driven experience for players who enjoy reading, exploring, and getting emotionally invested in characters.

If you loved To the Moon, Life is Strange, or Night in the Woods, you'll feel right at home with Nostalgic Joe - And The Fairy Whispers.

A soundtrack that blends 80s synths, 90s melodies, and early-2000s Frutiger Aero vibes.
Character designs strongly inspired by 90s–00s anime — Joe himself carries traces of Kaji (Evangelion), Kintaro (Golden Boy), and Kamon (FLCL).

This is a story about hope, nostalgia, and the little things that keep us moving forward.
A love letter to pop culture and to every generation that ever grew up dreaming in front of a glowing screen.
